Handover tips for a balanced watch
Please take a moment
Travelers, read this now so your companion animal can move through Aurelia Skyways without delays.

Companion Animal Travel Desk - urgent travel notice

Bring your pet paperwork, stay close to the check-in lane, and keep the carrier ready for inspection. Our team needs a clear handoff, and the cabin team will watch animals during flight so the plan stays steady from gate to landing. <<FACT F067>>

If you are moving with a cat or another companion animal, pack the carrier the right way, keep the door secure, and avoid loose items that can shift inside. Talia Hernandez and Alina Suleiman should also keep collars, leads, and any comfort items easy to reach, since quick checks help us keep the line moving and reduce stress for everyone.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away if anything changes, if your papers are missing, or if your pet looks unwell before departure. Companion Animal Travel Desk
